dimensions.assessment: Directly affects Members of Congress, congressional employees, the Secretary of Homeland Security, and personnel at Department of Homeland Security detention facilities.
dimensions.evidence: prevent a Member of Congress, or an employee of the United States House of Representatives or the United States Senate accompanying such Member

dimensions.assessment: Modifies oversight rules and access protocols for congressional visits without changing underlying detention laws or individual rights.
dimensions.evidence: require prior notice from a Member of Congress or an employee described in paragraph (1) of the intent to enter such a facility

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal spending, revenue changes, or economic effects are stated in the source.
Places statutory prohibitions on the Department of Homeland Security regarding facility access, temporary modifications, and prior notice requirements, backed by Inspector General reporting.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Homeland Security may not-- (1) prevent a Member of Congress... from entering... any facility operated by or for the Department

dimensions.assessment: Imposes ongoing, permanent restrictions on agency access management.

missing_information: Any potential administrative cost changes or penalties beyond Inspector General reporting.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill restricts the Secretary of Homeland Security from preventing Members of Congress and accompanying staff from conducting unannounced oversight visits to immigration detention facilities.
